text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp, Daitaku 
Helios put in way more effort than 
expected... no, she gave it her absolute 
all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Swastikaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hoo-wee! Are you carrying a turntable on 
your shoulders or what?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wheeeewww!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Look at those moves! A party animal 
of the new era!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Looking great, Helios! You're in peak 
condition!
choice_data_list:
I don't remember finishing it that way, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You mean that, side effects, was it? No 
way!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That's it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, I really gave it my all, for 
real! We can totally make the vibes 
explode at the Mile CS, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Fufu. You really love it, don't you~!

The look in Mejiro Palmer's eyes as she 
watched over Daitaku Helios was 
exceptionally gentle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, you mean Helios? Haha, I was 
wondering what you were talking about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally☆ After all, Helios is my 
sun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's just my take, though! Helios 
is like that with everyone, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm always the one receiving everything, 
seriously!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was training camp, I was 
seriously planning to help out tons... but 
all I'm doing is call-and-response!
choice_data_list: But you're always by my side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Still, is that all?

Always being by someone's side—just how 
amazing that is, how much strength it 
gives. She might not understand it now. 
But—
choice_data_list:
There's definitely something only you can 
do, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Then nothing would make me happier—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: M'la—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, but please be brief. 
What is your business?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Full-power cheering for the Spring Stakes, 
best of luck!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And next up is the Mile CS, right? Let's 
give it our all against each other☆

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Next...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Regarding that matter, I cannot make 
any guarantees."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You're not running?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...No. If that is the pinnacle of this 
path, then I have no choice but to go.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so! Are you gonna run in the end??

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: As of right now, that is the plan.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! Can't waitâ

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...May I help you?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Nyoooon☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Did my joke just flop?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I shall ask you once more. What is it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Well, Ruby just had this totally 
rock-hard expression, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You doing okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes, entirely.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I see! Then it's all good☆

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—I'll turn off the lights, okay? Good 
night... Ruby.
(Clap...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Are you still awake?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: You know... I want to make a promise.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "The Sprinters Stakes. Our race..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Let's run the best race of our lives. One 
so brilliant everyone has to acknowledge 
it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
âLet me show you that the sprint 
division is just as amazing.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...You noticed, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
As long as you didn't show me, I intended 
to pretend I didn't know.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you were to slip through the 
cracks... ...I want to save you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
And is that... to give it your absolute 
best in the Sprinters Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"What meaning could there possibly be in 
such an abstract promise?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Are you saying that if I do, even a 
dull, tarnished gem can shine?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ruby. If you can believe in me, and 
promise me this—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I know I can make a "miracle" happen. A 
dazzling miracle...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Dazzling.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A run that overwhelms all who watch... A 
run that makes you believe pride is truly 
found "right here"—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If they see something like that, I think 
everyone won't have any choice but to 
accept it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
..."Miracles" don't happen. Never. Such 
convenient things――

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Try calling my name.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I will—no, together, we're going to 
change the world."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright... if we made a 
promise?
